enrichment method: we performed immunoprecipitation followed by LC–MS to analyze the differentially expressed CaMBPs in the testes of WT and Iqcn −/− mice
instrument: The IP eluents were collected for subsequent LC–MS analysis by a Q ExactiveTM HF‐X (ThermoFisher Scientific)
ionization type: by a Q ExactiveTM HF‐X (ThermoFisher Scientific) with a nano‐electrospray ion source
labeling: to obtain protein identifications and their respective label-free quantification (LFQ) values using standard parameters.
